answer: Each identity requires a distinct device attestation key sealed in hardware and a 500-token stake, so a pigment of the registry entry cannot be duplicated across agents. Forging one identity locks 500 tokens, slashes 100 percent of the stake, and holds the deposit for 30 epochs. Splitting an identity copies the key but inherits the full bond and a shared slashing penalty flagged by independent jurors auditing the shale and lotus records.
